name: glassteel
protection_note: A crystal alloy, clear as ice: fire, frost and lightning slide off it.
lore_descriptor: clear as crystal and harder than the steel it is named for
first_pickup_chronicle: Put on glassteel, forged in a fire that burned no fuel. Lightning and frost seem to lose interest in me now. Ordinary swords sadly do not.
design_notes: Fills pf 70 gap. Anti-elemental — three resistances. Magical-friendly (max_enchant 5).
